text: Seal Island there was once famous for great whites leaping clear of the water after seals.
speaker: ryan
about: Qwen3-TTS speaker 'ryan': calm, measured and serious, an even tone at a moderate pace. Chosen by measurement from many takes: lines recorded against it keep the flattest tone (about 4 semitones of movement) and the steadiest pitch. Used for scripts whose mood reads as serious.
